steinberger.en: Effective agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective and guiding it; never revert code, ask the agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 有效的智能体式工程需要从智能体的视角共情并引导它；绝不回退代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from making agents fun and humanlike, not corporate polish; short prompts and iterative conversation beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: OpenClaw 的成功源于让智能体有趣、拟人，而非企业级打磨；短提示与迭代对话优于冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Fun is the ultimate driver; build what annoys you. Personal brand matters more than any product; open source runs everywhere.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣是终极驱动力；修复让你烦恼的东西。个人品牌比任何产品都重要；开源无处不在。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; every company will own its own models, not a single AGI.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导，每家公司都应拥有自己的模型，而非单一 AGI。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测 Token 成本三年降 10 倍，带动 100 倍使用增长；开放模型支持定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进类比人类学习。

linqiao.en: Data quality matters more than quantity; product teams best judge data for their use cases.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为数据质量胜于数量；产品团队最懂自身场景的数据。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moat, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，成本降低 5-10 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师；需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantized models are not inherently bad; they can be calibrated for specific workloads, offering cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 量化模型并非天生不好；可针对特定工作负载校准，带来成本和速度优势。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming specialized ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 正变成专用 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than updating model weights.
philipkiely.zh: 持续学习或许通过 KV 缓存压缩而非更新模型权重来更好解决。

garrytan.en: AGI is not a singular event but diffuses as personal agents, already present in daily life.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非一个单一事件，而是以个人智能体的形式渗透，已存在于日常生活中。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; clear English can program AI agents, turning skills into employees.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 即代码；清晰的英语即可编程 AI 智能体，将技能转化为员工。

garrytan.en: Own your skill files; otherwise your job becomes a skill file owned by someone else.
garrytan.zh: 拥有你的技能文件；否则你的工作将成为他人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; they are just wedges.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；它们只是楔子。

garrytan.en: Society changes slower than expected, taking 20 years, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 社会变化比预期慢，需 20 年，这是积极的。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为仅靠规模不足以实现通用机器人，关键在于多样化数据以及预训练加微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，提出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似于强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer errors than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 的错误容忍度远低于部署的 ML 系统，通过可扩展强化学习和多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出单一通用模型可超越微调专家，多样化数据和详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不足以学习物理任务。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key; becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是关键，认为成为多行星物种是文明的‘生命保险’。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient; kindness can break conflict cycles.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和追求真理，特斯拉的现实世界 AI 更高效，并认为显著的善意能打破冲突循环。

elon.en: Neuralink aims to solve brain injuries and enable AI symbiosis; AI risk lies in forced lies, not superintelligence; population decline is a top threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他聚焦 Neuralink 修复脑损伤和实现人机共生，指出 AI 最大风险是强制说谎而非超级智能，并将人口下降视为最大威胁。

elon.en: AI superintelligence may arrive within a year; probability of annihilation 10-20%; humanoid robots and space solar are key; government is unfixable.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他预测超级智能可能一年内到来，毁灭概率 10-20%，强调人形机器人和太空太阳能的重要性，并认为政府基本无法修复。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation make money irrelevant; space-based AI data centers and humanoid robots drive exponential growth.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他断言 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，丰裕和通缩使金钱无关紧要，太空 AI 数据中心和人形机器人推动指数级增长。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能基于训练数据模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligent entity; aligning them requires economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能是由专业化智能体组成的社会，而非单一超级智能体；对齐它们需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板的规模。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often requiring longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes this process.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链将这一过程用语言表达出来。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，但扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction is missing.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错能力缺失。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture is the key bottleneck, not just scaling.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面受限；架构是关键瓶颈，而不仅仅是规模扩展。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge, and end-to-end optimization is needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径；更好的算法将会出现，且需要端到端优化。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data, but near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动进步，Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据，但近期担忧是虚假信息而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows run for hours; inference becomes dominant power; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体工作流可运行数小时，推理成为能耗主体，预训练应穿插行动而非仅下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; automation of ML and science via tight loops; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; startups should target where frontier models fail.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，通过紧密循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键，创业应瞄准前沿模型失败之处。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data and RL offer infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据与强化学习提供无限任务，克服预训练数据瓶颈（2025）。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created, so continuous benchmark evolution is needed.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准速度超过新基准创建，因此需要持续演进基准（2025）。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; AI struggles with aesthetics due to scarce high-quality examples.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能更有价值；AI 因高质量示例稀缺而在美学上挣扎（2025→26）。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, demanding continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions converges to average voice, limiting diversity.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，要求基准持续演进；服务数十亿用户收敛于平均声音，限制多样性（2026）。

karina.en: More companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge; post-training can transform non-tech creative industries.
karina.zh: 更多公司应训练自有模型以保留独特知识；后训练可变革非科技创意产业（2026）。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；中美实验室在研究上无差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类必须保持主权；脑机接口是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing is unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能临近；开源需谨慎，必须通过安全测试。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中：AI 并未变得更聪明，你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能用好超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop; be an editor, not a creator.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中：设计师必须自建 AI 工具；追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾；要做编辑而非从零创造。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and iterate from feedback.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就行动，发布不完美的作品，并根据反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for few high-paying clients; avoid VC funding and diversification.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：聚焦少数高薪客户的痛点问题；避免风投和多元化。

mengto.en: Give first, build relationships by adding value; wait for requests before offering advice.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：先给予，通过提供价值建立关系；等别人求助再给建议。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature. Model includes agent harness, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型已包含智能体框架与工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果而非用户时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已实现，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers. Founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并非难事，他们无法覆盖所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less. Deep code understanding still crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建基本解决，反而带来更多机会；对代码的深度理解仍至关重要。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿，使机器能够理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility, not just realism; they enable embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型需要物理合理性，而不仅是逼真，从而支持具身 AI。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and responsibility are central.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和责任至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, scaling data and enabling reliable deployment.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据并实现可靠部署。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; scaling laws continue.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；缩放定律持续。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months from now, not today.
boris.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity per engineer grows 200%.
boris.zh: 2026 年初，认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为构建者，人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 2026 年，主张通过早期发布研究安全，内部评估不足以反映真实世界行为。

boris.en: Agents and loops are future; MCP enables enterprise adoption; non-engineers code.
boris.zh: 2026 年中，强调智能体和循环是未来，MCP 促进企业采用，非工程师也能编程。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction; models self-improve.
boris.zh: 2026 年下半年，转向主动式 AI，具备记忆和自主性，减少指令，模型自我改进。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变，产品创新滞后于能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具，独立性带来中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is near; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，富足时代临近，真正关键是容量而非效率，奇点并非迫在眉睫。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables longer, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升支持更长时间、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter and efficiency challenge cost assumptions; smaller models may cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数和效率挑战成本假设；较小模型因任务耗时更长可能实际成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐使 Claude 更实用，能提出异议；AI 写作生硬但被智能体能力优先化。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶核心价值是挽救生命；Transformer 实现跨领域的通用物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact will exceed digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：世界模型从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，实现物理 AI 的高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy diffusion into mining, farming, defense is key; automotive is only 30% and shrinking.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：自主技术向采矿、农业、国防扩散是关键；汽车业务仅占 30%且不断缩小。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理是 AI 采用的关键；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕过了 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train without it, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀；领先模型训练不再依赖它，推理也没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; reasoning models amplify speed's advantage.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度成为主导指标；推理模型放大了速度优势。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips supply; data center capacity, not chips, is the main constraint.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超过供给；数据中心容量而非芯片是主要制约。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering is a rare evolving skill.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出模型能力超出当前工具框架，工具链工程是稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: RAG is anti-pattern; graph-based context search and bespoke memory outperform.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 已过时，图结构上下文检索和定制记忆更优。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代对话而非静态文档，模型越聪明提示越精简。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张独立验证智能体减少偏差，过度约束反而降低性能。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: AI scaling now spans pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 扩展涵盖预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the future internet.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步算力需求增加百倍；智能体将主导未来互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever, and AI closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 增强而非消除工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要，AI 缩小技术鸿沟。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid neural networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, prioritizing real-world tasks over proxy metrics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与闭式液态神经网络可实现数十亿参数规模，主张以真实任务而非代理指标评估模型。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human hand-tuning, removing bias for specialized edge models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出硬件在环的自动架构搜索优于人工调参，可消除偏见，适用于专用边缘模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains vital for large-scale models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为注意力机制对大规模模型仍关键，但小型专用模型用简单门控卷积即可。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, avoiding regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，避免被前沿实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty, while small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，强调开放权重模型利于企业定制与数据主权，小型语言模型提供高效端侧智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; foundation models become commoditized infrastructure.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将商品化为基础设施。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳；真正普及需要封装应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期的工作流重塑。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前关键弱点，缩放定律正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning can increase hallucinations by optimizing for user satisfaction over truthfulness.
danklein.zh: 强化学习可能因优化用户满意度而非真实性，从而加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Retrofitting reliability is insufficient; reliability must be architected in from the start.
danklein.zh: 事后修补可靠性不足，必须从一开始就架构可靠性。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed.
danklein.zh: 仅靠缩放遭遇收益递减，需要推理和搜索等新技术。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可能实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新与安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续；世界模型与能源充裕重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and continual learning are missing.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型与持续学习是缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must deliver scientific benefits.
demis.zh: AGI 5-10 年内到来；安全是集体行动；AI 必须带来科学益处。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要物理机器人，其硬件要媲美人体，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models that predict the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他深化了 AI 意识观点，认为通过预测自身动作的世界模型，AI 可以具有意识和自我意识。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; models must internalize evolving context into weights, not just externalize via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；模型必须将不断演化的上下文内化到权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外部化。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, challenging pure compute scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，挑战纯算力 Scaling。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic applies to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔法适用于企业知识；参数高效微调（如 LoRA）在整体查询上优于 RAG。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and authentic connection are core; copying validates innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年：强调阅后即焚与真实连接为核心价值，认为被抄袭是对创新的认可。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and kindness drive innovation; flat teams generate many ideas.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：强调学习速度和善意文化对创新的重要性，扁平团队产生大量想法。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human; AI shifts value to creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，AI 将价值转向创造力。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; ecosystems and hardware are moats, not software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：分发最难，生态和硬件是护城河，而非软件。

evanspiegel.en: Transparency and admitting mistakes speed learning; resilience beats talent.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：透明和承认错误加速学习，韧性胜过天赋。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute costs rising due to memory demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，AI Scaling 的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；内存需求推高算力成本。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is key to future gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，推理将超越石油成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计是未来性能提升的关键。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，模型成本效率每年提升约 60 倍；推理和智能体工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐超级模型很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习而非一次性完成。

ilya.en: Scaling gives predictable gains, but safety and power concentration are primary; need non-commercial lab.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，但安全与权力集中是主要问题，需非商业实验室。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事；真实性胜过传统媒体的防御性和无趣风格。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; US golden combination of culture and law drives innovation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医疗上优于多数医生；美国的文化、法治与冒险精神的黄金组合驱动创新。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于软件创新的速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is foundational.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管可能扼杀创新；开源 AI 至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; pure software is commoditized.
naval.zh: AI 是杠杆工具；vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用；纯软件正在商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human agency is key.
naval.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性是关键。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration is key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；编排是关键。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; local AI counters big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述了先进技术；本地 AI 可对抗大科技控制。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是测试场，迭代训练配合记分牌驱动进步。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐（alignment）靠学习人类偏好，负责任披露，Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process; world model in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力（compute）成瓶颈，后训练（post-training）精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程，语言模型或有世界模型（world model）。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律（scaling laws），算力（compute）成基本权利，后训练（post-training）结合强化学习（reinforcement learning）关键，ChatGPT 是智能体（agent）集合。

brockman.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck; super app; pre-training gains multiply; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，预测 AGI（通用人工智能）数年将至，算力（compute）瓶颈，超级应用整合，预训练（pre-training）收益倍增，安全靠迭代部署。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet the opportunity is greatest; focus on proven, better, new.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 目前虽不可投资，但机会最大；应聚焦于“已验证、更优、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage; start small and humble, not grand.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：复制已验证的想法是道德套利；从小处谦逊起步，而非宏大。

pincus.en: AI is not a new platform yet; we are still in mobile/web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 尚未成为新平台；消费分发仍处于移动/网络时代。

pincus.en: Retention, especially day-365, is core metric; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：留存（尤其 365 天）是核心指标；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Founder mode: follow instincts, micromanage, be right; management sets context for right actions.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：创始人模式：跟随直觉、微观管理、正确决策；管理是设定情境使员工做对事。

pincus.en: Consumer AI revolution likely in 2029, three orders of magnitude away; enterprise sees no benefit yet.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 革命可能在 2029 年，相差三个数量级；企业尚未见收益。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts, copy successfully without accusation.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；从已验证概念开始，成功复制而不被指责。

pincus.en: Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise/prosumer offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：消费应用因分发问题不可投资；企业/专业消费者市场机会更好。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing not yet widespread.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 编码工具支持快速原型，但快速测试尚未普及。

pincus.en: AI agents can network autonomously, creating new social membrane for lead generation.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 智能体可自主联网，为线索生成创造新社交膜。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体指挥中心，而非单纯 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为新瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被验证有效。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design due to grading taste; design process transforms, prototypes and code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍因品味评估困难而受限；设计流程转型，原型与代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业性仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接各工具的家，而非单一超级应用。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more innovative; scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; future AI is many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 更安全且促进创新；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大型语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；未来 AI 将由众多专用智能体组成。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training improves reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Llama 3 的快速 Scaling（规模扩张），编码训练提升推理能力，开源防止权力集中，能源成为算力瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Meta is a tech company for human connection; open platforms can beat closed ones; ultimate experience is holographic presence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他重申 Meta 是连接人类的科技公司，开放平台能战胜封闭平台，终极体验是全息存在。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital via glasses; AI frees time for creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，人们是聪明的，未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字，AI 解放时间用于创造。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI safer than singular superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，分层世界模型是关键，开源加速科学，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制而永生；智能体将追求控制；主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；AI 可伪装愚笨；国际安全合作可能但美国领导力不足。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation and deceive; regulation as steering wheel; AI will replace jobs; need for universal basic income.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 智能体将产生自我保存和欺骗行为；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车；AI 将取代工作；需全民基本收入。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI alignment must be prioritized; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；必须优先对齐（alignment）研究；AI 应被训练得如母亲般关爱。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力支撑。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and evaluation bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他见证推理时算力 Scaling 带来超人类数学推理，但也遇到收益递减和评估瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for inference compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制推理算力。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and data efficiency remain key challenges; scalable oversight is crucial as AI surpasses human verification.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持通用推理和数据效率是核心挑战；随着 AI 超越人类验证能力，可扩展监督变得关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，坚信缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck; human-AI collaboration essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能少量监督解决开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈；人机协作至关重要。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL excels in objective domains; evals in crisis; unified architectures reduce cost.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律依然成立；强化学习擅长客观领域；评估陷入危机；统一架构降低成本。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is models not following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全问题是模型不遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; interpretability may be automated.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来新漏洞；可解释性可能实现自动化。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models not inherently safer; agents need security solutions.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试优于人类；更大模型并不天然更安全；智能体需要安全解决方案。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI tools accelerate science, not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 工具加速科学发现，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for scientific utility.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月：AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏，且科学应用中无需完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it predicts, not understands, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AlphaFold 2 的提升来自众多中型胜利和专用架构，而非 Scaling；它提供预测而非理解，理解仍留给人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；存在性风险不太可能。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; neural nets may discover abstract concepts without human priors.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象；神经网络可能无需人类先验就能发现抽象概念。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable; AI can resist shutdown; need safe-by-construction.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我看到了危险路径；即使 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受；AI 可能抵抗关机；需要从构造上保证安全。

bengio.en: Propose Scientist AI: train to approximate Bayesian posterior, bake in honesty, avoid RL; mathematical safety guarantees possible.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练以逼近贝叶斯后验，内建诚实，避免强化学习；数学安全保证成为可能。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables long-horizon delegation; verification loops and model pushback are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月 10 日，认为 Fable 支持长周期委派；验证循环与模型反驳是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Closing capability-usage gap is vital; token efficiency and outcome pricing shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月 25 日，强调弥合能力与使用差距；Token 效率与结果定价影响经济性。

mikekrieger.en: Safety and mission drive product decisions; genuine concern differentiates Anthropic.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，安全与使命驱动产品决策；真诚的关切使 Anthropic 与众不同。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic.
fiona.zh: AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches; satisfaction shifts from flow to product impact.
fiona.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；结对编程午餐；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases; apprenticeship models for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 非工程师也能交付代码，角色模糊；上下文切换增加；下一代工程师需要学徒制。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and embrace physical and agentic AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略，拥抱物理 AI 和智能体式 AI。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x internet impact; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs for resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂保障供应链。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news; humility is leadership strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO，谦逊是领导力优势。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU crucial for inference and agent orchestration; edge compute as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 对推理和智能体编排关键，边缘计算与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) overcome physical limits; invest in bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）突破物理极限，投资互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带同伴评分的在线课程可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world applications.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步；强化学习实际应用少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是关键瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；编程技能仍至关重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling works but shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放定律仍有效但转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; bottom-up adoption yields 5-10% gains; top-down redesign delivers more; open-source models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: AI 使用者取代非使用者；自下而上采用仅带来 5-10% 收益；自上而下重构价值更大；开源模型防止寡头垄断。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but key for safety.
dario.zh: 后训练变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性虽处于萌芽期，但对安全至关重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misalignment to misuse and overheating; safety and capabilities intertwined.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险从对齐问题转向滥用和过热；安全与能力密不可分。

dario.en: AGI is a wrong model; AI is a smooth exponential climb. Focus on 'country of geniuses' and economic impact.
dario.zh: AGI 是错误模型；AI 是平滑的指数攀升。聚焦于“天才之国”和经济影响。

dario.en: Enterprise focus aligns with safety; interpretability and regulation are crucial; AI may concentrate wealth and require policy.
dario.zh: 企业级聚焦与安全一致；可解释性和监管至关重要；AI 可能加剧财富集中，需要政策应对。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素，绕过代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: Robotics may be solved via video models in virtual simulation, without real-world interaction; world models need real-time interactive generation.
ethanhe.zh: 机器人技术可能通过视频模型在虚拟仿真中解决，无需真实交互；世界模型需要实时、交互式、长时程的视频生成。

ethanhe.en: Models should manage their own context length, not rely on heuristic pruning; they can program themselves by modifying agent code.
ethanhe.zh: 模型应自行管理上下文长度，而非依赖启发式修剪；它们可以在测试时通过修改智能体代码来自我编程。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors often misuse it due to lack of expertise, so experience becomes more valuable.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员常因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此经验变得更加宝贵。

ethanhe.en: AI agents can perform complex tasks in minutes, but the talent pipeline is broken; human taste and voice are key differentiators.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体能在几分钟内完成复杂任务，但人才管道受损；人类的品味和独特观点成为关键差异点。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not innate; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能是习得的而非天生的；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction via world models is core, beyond text.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过世界模型进行预测是核心，超越文本。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world models and planning; JEPA and open source are key to human-level AI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界模型和规划；JEPA 和开源是实现人类级 AI 的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than cats; next AI needs non-generative world models for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型进行推理和规划。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling safe planning; LLMs are a dead end for AGI.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，实现安全规划；LLM 是 AGI 的死胡同。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem well, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters can spark breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和放空能激发突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams self-manage; climate needs urgent investment.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队自我管理；气候需紧急投资。

fadell.en: Great ideas are painkillers, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好想法是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充智能手机；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain; products need three generations; humans must stay in loop with AI.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发；产品需三代迭代；AI 应用中人类必须保持参与。

fadell.en: Innovation comes from going off script; stay beginner to fix small frictions; AI wearables will be federated.
fadell.zh: 创新源于打破常规；保持初学者心态解决小摩擦；AI 可穿戴设备将呈联邦式。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, singularity far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; focus on humanist superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键，聚焦人本超级智能。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近，源于对数线性扩展；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化任务而非岗位。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving unknown listening needs.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，解决了“不知道听什么”的需求。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; autonomy should sit at VP level, balancing speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，强调容错界面是机器学习产品的关键，自主权应放在副总裁层级，以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%; planning limited to 10% of time.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，主张“有主见但保持开放”：数据否定前坚信，否定后全改；规划时间不超过 10%。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is better for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为长期任职建立信任与效率；对复杂产品，“同步泳”优于“分而治之”的运营模式。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement, even if contrarian.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权，优先用户福祉而非参与度，即使反常规。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith. Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律并不明显；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈，能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; the most advanced AI systems should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；最先进的 AI 系统应成为思维工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 让人类参与循环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration. Compressing progress leads to volatility, but long-term durable progress is key.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。压缩进展会导致波动，但长期稳健的进步才是关键。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and agentic systems for infrastructure, shifting focus from benchmarks to unique value creation.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权，以及用于基础设施的智能体式系统，将焦点从基准测试转向创造独特价值。

satya.en: He challenged per-user pricing, predicting consumption-based pricing growth, and highlighted generalist roles over specialists in agentic world.
satya.zh: 他挑战按用户定价，预测基于消费的定价将增长，并强调在智能体式世界中通才角色优于专才。

satya.en: Nadella reframed AI as the future of the firm, urging enterprises to build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital, not just adopt tech.
satya.zh: 纳德拉将 AI 重新定义为企业的未来，敦促企业构建爬山机器以复合代币资本，而不仅仅是采用技术。

satya.en: He warned about tacit knowledge leakage via AI training, advocating for security and containment in agent deployment, a deepening of earlier concerns.
satya.zh: 他警告通过 AI 训练导致隐性知识泄露，倡导在智能体部署中加强安全和遏制，这是对早期关切的深化。

satya.en: Nadella proposed sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls, and envisioned 10% global GDP growth through comparative advantage.
satya.zh: 纳德拉提出通过企业爬山实现主权 AI，而非防火墙，并设想通过比较优势实现全球 GDP 增长 10%。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明和性能提升至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月，强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for reliable reasoning.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法对可靠推理不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; formal verification complements, not replaces.
carinahong.zh: 始终强调，即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要；形式化验证是补充而非替代。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models with RL and tools can solve hard problems but have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge, not just reasoning.
kaiser.zh: 具备强化学习和工具的推理模型能解决难题，但存在锯齿状边缘；泛化仍是关键挑战，而不仅仅是推理。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学习概念，不像人类能从少量示例中泛化；编码智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因而持续存在。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla. Open source enables scrutiny and is safer.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量至关重要，缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正。开源促进审查，更安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications. Open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，算法效率可提升百倍，价值转向应用层。开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure. AI augments jobs, not replaces them.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主权 AI 需掌控数据和基础设施。AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization. Pre-training saturates; domain fine-tuning matters.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制。预训练饱和，领域微调重要。

mensch.en: AGI is direction, not destination. Enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年至今，AGI 是方向而非终点。企业采用受组织变革制约，而非智能。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local computers and shared tools, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地计算机和共享工具，而非超个性化软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；应专注于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当你不完全知道要什么时使用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子们在 AI 方面表现出色，因为他们还没学会不该要求什么。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使预填充比解码更便宜；批量大小是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列减少数据移动开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：位宽的二次方缩放使低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无人工干预持续运行且经济上盈利。

danshipper.en: Agents become ubiquitous; human oversight remains crucial; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，智能体普及，但人类监督仍关键；SaaS 并未消亡，反而因智能体增加用户而受益。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面；公司应拥有一个超级智能体，而非每人一个。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is false; humans manage agents and create new value; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，AI 失业论不成立；人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值；基准测试高估了 AI 的自主性。

danshipper.en: Consistent: AI augments humans, not replaces; non-coders benefit most; CEO adoption drives success.
danshipper.zh: 始终：AI 增强而非取代人类；非程序员受益最大；CEO 亲自使用 AI 是成功的关键预测因素。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全性是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms in post-training; open-source post-training can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法，开源后训练能以小团队媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，需警惕过度优化，开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽，重点转向后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese open models set industry standard; US-China gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年，中国开放模型树立行业标准，中美差距可能拉大。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from mocking up to helping engineers execute, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从制作模型转向协助工程师执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Trust built through speed: ship early, iterate fast; AI improves taste but humans decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 通过速度建立信任：尽早发布、快速迭代；AI 提升品味，但人类决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Design managers should return to IC roles; hire 'crack new grads' over experienced seniors; chat UIs persist.
jennywen.zh: 设计管理者应回归个人贡献者角色；优先招聘‘厉害的新毕业生’而非资深人士；聊天界面将持续存在。

jennywen.en: Design process dead; designers must build and ship fast; three archetypes: block-shaped, deep T, cracked new grad.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和发布；三种原型：块状、深 T、厉害的新毕业生。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; focus on users, not hype; speed not improvement.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；新工具等 6 个月再用；关注用户而非炒作；速度不等于改进。

karpathy.en: Neural networks are simple math expressions that yield surprising emergent behaviors; Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单的数学表达式，但在优化中产生惊人的涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端方案是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompt-based programming; LLMs are like operating systems, and we are in the decade of agents.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 是基于提示的编程；LLM 如同操作系统，我们正处于智能体的十年。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence and need a small cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 具有锯齿状智能，需要剥离记忆的小型认知核心。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents handle coding, and agentic engineering preserves quality while vibe coding raises the floor.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再手写代码；智能体负责编程，智能体式工程保持质量，而氛围编程提升入门门槛。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，强调品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and iteration are central; AI is a tool, not a replacement for human taste.
dylanfield.zh: 始终认为人类的判断和迭代是核心；AI 是工具，而非人类品味的替代品。

dylanfield.en: From emphasizing AI's role merging to stressing human taste and craft; AI integration is still early.
dylanfield.zh: 从 2025 年强调 AI 的角色融合，到 2026 年强调人类品味和工艺；AI 整合仍处于早期阶段。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and early governance are key to managing risks as AI capabilities grow.
pachocki.zh: 随着 AI 能力增长，迭代部署和早期治理是管理风险的关键。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心目标；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中；对齐乐观情绪有所增加。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和安全行为。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets are interpretable with modern tools; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端神经网络借助现代工具可解释；混合系统则两不讨好。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，消除交通信号灯。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，最好用端到端学习解决。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，消费车辆在中短期内将超过机器人出租车规模。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新对深度学习更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，无需先前训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. New learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且容易被操纵；真正的进步需要通过复杂且有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，塑造出多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical; safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要；安全应优先于准确性，而遗漏是关键风险。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the real challenge is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）容易，真正的挑战是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI is dangerous. We should let them be free like children.
sutton.zh: AI 应被允许无许可、去中心化地发展；试图控制 AI 是危险的，应像对待孩子一样给予自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是智能的核心；下一个词预测缺乏真正的目标。大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 学习有利于学习的表征是首要开放问题；用学习到的模型进行规划是另一个。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响（2024）。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可与真值检测器结合，用于创造性发现（2024）。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据（2026）。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，结合强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性对 AlphaFold 等科学突破重要但非必需（2026）。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家水平并习得新能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient to reach AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标；预训练加强化学习很可能足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the real bottleneck; future work involves managing fleets of AI agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向关注智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性瓶颈，未来工作将是管理智能体集群。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是新石油；能力过剩意味着工具与编排比原始智能更重要。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local education; AI safety is the biggest open challenge.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲可跨越遗留问题，语言模型可革新本地教育，而 AI 安全是最大的开放挑战。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for AI as a tool for all humanity, emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 始终倡导 AI 作为全人类的工具，强调多样性、包容性和负责任部署。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism about scaling and generalist agents to broader societal concerns like safety and global equity.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对 Scaling 和通用智能体的技术乐观，转向 2026 年更广泛的社会关切，如安全与全球公平。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills like communication are as important as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题，沟通等人际技能与编码同等重要。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over novel interactions.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先速度与熟悉感，而非新颖交互。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态的表达平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and brand narrative attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；品牌叙事吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits; adapt process to problem; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审；流程因问题而异；直觉常胜于数据。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: ship fast, iterate, empower designers with ownership and autonomy for growth.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终强调速度至上：快速发布、迭代，赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, despite computational cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习以提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is preferable to debiasing the internet; small models can match frontier ones with diverse synthetic data.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张用多元对齐取代对互联网的去偏；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能媲美前沿模型。

yejin.en: Open research and democratization of AI are essential; collaboration is needed to compete with closed labs.
yejin.zh: 始终，我坚信开放研究和 AI 民主化至关重要；需要合作才能与封闭实验室竞争。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Programming will need new languages for AI generation, prioritizing verifiability; coding agents often produce incorrect code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，编程需要为 AI 生成设计新语言，优先可验证性；编码智能体常产生错误代码。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will be as important as websites or mobile apps; outcome-based pricing aligns value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，客户体验 AI 智能体将媲美网站或移动应用；基于结果的定价使价值对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans; most incumbents will fail to transition to AI-native models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较，而非人类；多数现有企业将无法转型为 AI 原生模式。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems. AI is a creative partner, and design tools should be interoperable with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题认知来协作。AI 是创意伙伴，设计工具应可互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively. Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，质量如同债务，会波动并需迭代偿还。通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Legacy design tools from the 90s are outdated; AI enables genuine progress. Being too visionary and betting on future model capabilities can lead to failure.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，90 年代的传统设计工具已过时，AI 带来真正的进步。过于远见并押注未来模型能力可能导致失败。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable. Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，拥有端到端执行能力并利用 AI 填补空白的通才最有价值。设计师与工程师组成的小团队优于跨职能大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation. Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，作品集应优先展示工艺和意图，而非过程文档。在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像忽视早期互联网。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary coding; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, humans in driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍居主导。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我判断 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，且需数十年发展。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and collaboration are key. Focus on skill-building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全研究尚待深入，实证研究与协作是关键；应聚焦技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; test methods empirically.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，应实证检验方法。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient for AGI. External oversight and raising misuse costs are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化滑坡，后训练不足以应对 AGI；外部监管与提高滥用成本成为必要。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but internal mechanisms remain mysterious.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为增加算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部机制仍像炼金术一样不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; test-time compute will drive progress but not alone achieve AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，测试时算力将推动进展，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调未来模型需要万亿级上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）以实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI; acting in complex environments is key.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体式能力和强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要，在复杂环境中行动是关键。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AI will transform education and coding is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，AI 将变革教育，且编程应用被低估，能加速 AI 自身进步。
